payload.title: [Figs. 3-4] LMRonline
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook investigates the spectral properties of the LMRonline ensemble and reproduces Figures 3-4 from a related paper. It compares the online data assimilation (DA) ensemble with the offline DA by subsampling and applying spectral analysis techniques. The notebook uses various statistical methods to estimate autoregressive model parameters and visualize the results through plots. The outputs include spectral density estimates, autoregressive parameters, and visualizations such as violin plots and autocovariance fits.
goals: Investigate spectral properties of the LMRonline ensemble
Compare online and offline data assimilation ensembles

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook begins by setting up the environment and loading the LMRonline ensemble data to investigate its spectral properties and reproduce figures from a related paper.
section_blurbs.heading: [Figs. 3-4] LMRonline

section_blurbs.blurb: This section subsamples the online DA ensemble and applies spectral analysis techniques, including anti-alias filtering and spectral exponent estimation, to compare with offline DA.
section_blurbs.heading: Online DA: Original ensemble

section_blurbs.blurb: Autoregressive model parameters are estimated using the statsmodels library, with robust covariance estimation, and the results are visualized using kernel density plots.
section_blurbs.heading: Estimate AR model parameters

section_blurbs.blurb: The estimated autoregressive model parameters are exported to a CSV file for further analysis or documentation.
section_blurbs.heading: Export to CSV

section_blurbs.blurb: Violin plots are generated to provide a compact visualization of the autoregressive model fit, highlighting the distribution of coefficients.
section_blurbs.heading: Violin Plots

section_blurbs.blurb: Although not used in the final paper, this section explores autocovariance through exponential fitting and theoretical ACF computation, providing additional insights into the data.
section_blurbs.heading: Autocovariance

outputs: CSV file with AR model parameters
Plots including line density, violin plots, and autocovariance
